name: docx-tool
description: Teach AI agents to inspect and edit DOCX documents through a self-describing, bounded CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and edit Word documents safely
interface.longDescription: A focused Agent Skill for a versioned agent contract, bounded DOCX inspection, transactional edits, comments, and revisions.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this DOCX and summarize its structure.
Apply these Word-document edits and verify them.
Review the tracked changes in this DOCX.
